scientific_integrity: Exact elementary proof of all-parameter cubic irreducibility; the already-known discriminant square condition is clearly credited to Banerjee--Filaseta--Finch--Leidy (2013).
scientific_limitations: Applies to degree 3 and integral a≥0 only.
The discriminant and square locus predate this result; novelty concerns uniform irreducibility.
Independent audit has not yet been performed.
An unindexed equivalent argument may exist.
title: Uniform irreducibility and Galois groups of cubic generalized Laguerre polynomials
